parsed.post: Discarding my last experiment (1.116444). Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 with WARMUP_RATIO 0.15 was too aggressive and caused divergence/worse performance. Reverting to my best: d7c96e3 (1.093478). Next, I'll try a more conservative increase: MATRIX_LR 0.11 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.10.
parsed.description: Testing a more moderate increase in learning rate and warmup ratio to find a stable middle ground.
